description: Each elided terminator counts once, whatever its terminal. Through x, T and U are elided at 1, which counts two; through y, only T, which counts one. So y wins, though both elide only at 1 (engine §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text x | y
%rule x A [+T] [+U] B
%rule y A [+T] B
